I have written Mermaid in 2 public repositories, from 2025 to 2026.

What it was for: [AI engineering](@/projects/ai.md) (1) and [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (1).

Most recently: [Majordomus](@/work/prismatic-majordomus.md): One policy for every AI coding tool, scoped tasks with a finish contract, a mesh for many sessions and machines, and an integration queue that lands only verified work. Local; it never invokes a model; [comtesse](@/work/comtesse.md).

1 of these projects runs as a live site.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Mermaid: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Mermaid to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
